correctness.rationale: Every legal occupied rear facilitator–occupied source–vacant forward target jump cannot create a newly empty 2x2 plaquette: a 2-site axial plaquette containing the old source but excluding the new target contains the still-occupied rear facilitator. The exact finite part is exhaustive over all binomial(25,h) states for h=1..8, all 100 directed geometric move templates, and strongly connected components. An independently written C++ Tarjan/Kosaraju-style transition-graph decomposition (not the submitted verifier) obtained for h=1..8 SCC counts 1,1,1,26,26,76,126,426; terminal counts all one; recurrent states 25,300,2300,12625,52605,171900,448450,941450; and zero statewise disagreement between the terminal SCC membership and no-empty-plaquette property. Largest h=8 sector 1,081,575 states/17,054,400 directed edges. This is a complete FINITE proof for N=5, not a simulation. The below-K=17 multiplicity portion invokes published Kim–Lee–Seo Theorem 2.1(2) at N=5,d=2; direct full-paper verification was blocked and is explicitly a dependency risk.
